newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes 3.9 higher at 1,071.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes 3.9 higher at 1,071.

text.p: Colombia's made a slight comeback in active interbank trading after closing at a record-low of 1,074.90 against the dollar Monday.
Dealers said the peso edged up 3.9 versus the dollar in Tuesday's see-saw trade, ending at 1,071.
The local currency appeared to be heading for another historic low early in the day, when it dipped to 1,085.50. But it bounced back on dollar-sales by banks and the corporate sector, dealers said.
They reported 445 trades for a total of $208 million and said the peso's high for the day was 1,070.
